summary: Prediction, not yet built: no new runtime nodes over Part 1 -- the landing app gains an in-browser architecture explorer reading the CALM timeline directly.

nodes.label: Reader
nodes.purpose: A blog reader who now also explores Bullpen's own architecture timeline on the landing site.

nodes.label: Player
nodes.purpose: Opens the trading app to see live prices. Paper trades arrive in Part 4.

nodes.label: Bullpen Landing
nodes.purpose: The public landing site, now rendering an in-browser architecture explorer that reads the docify-generated CALM diagrams and timeline for every part.

nodes.label: Bullpen Trading App
nodes.purpose: The trading app where players view live prices and place paper trades.

nodes.label: Price Snapshot Service
nodes.purpose: Serverless function backing GET /api/price/[symbol]; fetches a point-in-time price for a symbol from the external market-data provider.

nodes.label: Market Data Provider
nodes.purpose: External market-data API Bullpen calls for live price snapshots. Provider still TBD pending a terms-of-use-compliant choice.

steps.caption: Ask for a quote
steps.detail: The trading app requests a live price snapshot.

steps.caption: Fetch upstream
steps.detail: Server-side call to the (still TBD) market-data provider.

steps.caption: Return the snapshot
steps.detail: Bullpen's own shape, never the raw upstream payload.
